## Context

Owner intent, 2026-11-28 (dev-j6oqo), in his words: "the agents that produce incredible amount of temp files and branches and worktrees clean up after them selves. then there would be no need to do any follow up cleanup".

Today agents leave clones, worktrees, branches and temp folders behind, and a person cleans up by hand. On 2026-11-28 seven repair and CI clones held about 4.7 GB and unpushed work (basicly-e7h74ec), and ~/.cache/basicly-kits held 258 digest folders where only the current one is needed. The outcome wanted: every folder, branch and worktree an agent makes is owned by a tracker record, and the record cannot close until its owner removes them or saves their unpushed work in a verified bundle.

uv, copilot, ms-playwright, puppeteer, .vscode-server, .codex and .claude caches, and ~/basicly-usage-archive (the owner's).
